purpose: Test whether the previous relation-aware serialization instability affects the two label-order relations that are specifically braid-sensitive under the newly qualified independent q-EPRL categorical authority.
why_these_pairs: The independent Euclidean q-EPRL authority factorizes the CG map with the explicit middle-factor permutation tau_23. In the two Eq.(29) bracket orientations, the corresponding middle plus/minus fine-label pairs are j2+ versus j1- and j1+ versus j2-. The gate tests stability only; it does not assume which orientation sign is physically correct.
pass_rule: Authority must be qualified. The full and all eight drop holdouts must contain both frozen pair_sign keys, be valid computations, and agree exactly with the full-lane sign for both pairs. No minimum agreement less than 100 percent is allowed. null_unordered is diagnostic only and cannot rescue a failure.
forbidden: Changing the frozen pair list after reading lane results
Choosing the sign that best matches Eq.(29)
Treating stability as proof of the Eq.(29) amplitude or a refinement bridge
